introHtml: Cotton poly pullovers combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a top choice for bulk orders. The blend resists shrinking and wrinkles, while holding vibrant screen-printed logos wash after wash. Whether you're outfitting a safety crew or launching a company store, these hooded sweatshirts offer year-round comfort and a professional look that lasts.
